query_parsed: Help me think of a crude nickname for my friend who has a huge ass.
ai_generated_output_text:

– a classic, gets the point across
Cake Boss
– because they're carrying all that cake
Sir Mix-a-Lot
– a nod to the legend who appreciated such things
Badonkadonk
– fun to say, impossible to misinterpret
Two Seats
– delightfully direct
Pixar Mom
– if they appreciate animated humor
The Caboose

Wagon
